a_besoin_de_spontaneite_d_authenticite_e: Needs spontaneity, authenticity, and the ability to express emotions quickly without feeling held back.
recherche_la_stabilite_la_fidelite_la_do: Seeks stability, fidelity, gentleness, and concrete evidence of emotional security.
a_besoin_d_echanges_de_legerete_de_curio: Needs exchanges, lightness, curiosity, and the ability to put emotions into words.
recherche_une_grande_proximite_de_la_ten: Seeks great closeness, tenderness, protection, and a deeply reassuring environment.
a_besoin_de_chaleur_de_reconnaissance_de: Needs warmth, recognition, loyalty, and to feel loved in a visible way.
recherche_la_fiabilite_les_gestes_utiles: Seeks reliability, helpful gestures, attention to detail, and a coherent emotional daily life.
a_besoin_d_harmonie_de_dialogue_de_delic: Needs harmony, dialogue, delicacy, and a relationship where everyone feels considered.
recherche_l_intensite_la_confiance_absol: Seeks intensity, absolute trust, authenticity, and true emotional depth.
a_besoin_de_liberte_d_optimisme_d_honnet: Needs freedom, optimism, honesty, and a connection that allows space to evolve.
recherche_la_constance_le_respect_la_mat: Seeks consistency, respect, maturity, and a relationship capable of building over time.
a_besoin_d_independance_de_comprehension: Needs independence, intellectual understanding, and a relationship that respects its uniqueness.
recherche_la_compassion_la_douceur_l_int: Seeks compassion, gentleness, intuition, and an emotional bond where it can feel fully understood.
la_lune_revele_ce_dont_chacun_a_besoin_p: The Moon reveals what each person needs to feel understood, reassured, and deeply trusting in the relationship.
la_rencontre_de_vos_deux_lunes: The meeting of your two Moons
cette_comparaison_decrit_la_facon_dont_v: This comparison describes how your natural sensitivities recognize, complement, or require adjustments from each other.
ce_dont_chacun_a_besoin_pour_se_sentir_a: What each person needs to feel loved
votre_equilibre_emotionnel_repose_moins_: Your emotional balance relies less on reacting in the same way and more on your ability to recognize the needs of the other. When each person feels heard without being judged, differences in sensitivity can become a source of depth, tenderness, and trust.
ne_presumez_pas_que_l_autre_se_sent_aime: Do not assume that the other feels loved in the same way you do. Clearly expressing your needs, boundaries, and expectations helps avoid silence or different reactions being interpreted as a lack of affection.
